model.title: Ventilation model settings
model.description: Adaptive ventilation logic. By default the threshold scales with dwelling size and moisture generation, targeting roughly 3–5 meaningful ventilation cycles per day.

data.repeat_recommendation_cooldown_min: Delay before a repeated recommendation (Default: 20 min)
data.repeat_min_benefit_ml: Minimum benefit for a repeated recommendation (Default: 80 ml)

data_description.threshold_mode: Recommended: adaptive to dwelling size. FreshAirIQ targets about four meaningful ventilation cycles per day and uses cool morning/evening opportunities earlier on warm days.
data_description.start_rh: Above this normal humidity level, a room is more likely to become a ventilation candidate. The absolute-humidity difference and potential must still be suitable.
data_description.high_rh: Above this level, FreshAirIQ lowers the required absolute-humidity difference so high indoor humidity is prioritized sooner.
data_description.target_rh: Guideline value for the end of successful dehumidification. FreshAirIQ also considers remaining potential, forecast and minimum/maximum duration.
data_description.min_delta: Minimum difference between indoor absolute humidity and reference air for normal dehumidification.
data_description.min_delta_high_rh: Reduced minimum difference when room humidity is already high.
data_description.close_delta: If the remaining absolute-humidity difference is smaller, further ventilation usually provides little additional moisture removal.
data_description.min_potential_percent_total_water: Percentage mode only: minimum share of the currently monitored water amount that should be removable.
data_description.min_potential_total_ml: Fixed mL mode only: minimum potential across all calculated rooms.
data_description.min_potential_room_ml: A single problematic room can be prioritized from this removable potential onward, independently of the house total.
data_description.min_duration_min: Before this point, FreshAirIQ normally does not recommend closing solely because additional benefit is declining.
data_description.max_duration_min: Upper limit for a normal ventilation recommendation. Safety/health logic may still react separately.
data_description.post_ventilation_stabilization_min: After closing, FreshAirIQ waits this long for sensor values and room air to stabilize before issuing a new recommendation.
data_description.repeat_recommendation_cooldown_min: Prevents the same recommendation from reappearing immediately after completed ventilation.
data_description.repeat_min_benefit_ml: A repeated recommendation during the cooldown period requires at least this much additional expected moisture benefit.
data_description.min_return_next_5_min_ml: Another five minutes should remove at least this additional amount of water; otherwise the benefit is considered too low.
data_description.max_temp_loss_next_5_min_c: Limits the additional temperature loss tolerated over the next five minutes.
data_description.min_efficiency_ml_per_01c: Evaluates how much moisture is removed per 0.1 °C of temperature loss.
data_description.surface_factor: Approximation factor for colder indoor surfaces. Lower values mean stronger assumed cooling toward outdoor temperature.
data_description.mould_warn_surface_rh: Above this estimated surface humidity, FreshAirIQ reports elevated mould risk.
data_description.mould_critical_surface_rh: Above this estimated surface humidity, mould risk is considered critical.
data_description.co2_warn: Above this CO₂ value, ventilation priority increases when a CO₂ sensor is available.
data_description.co2_critical: Above this CO₂ value, air quality is treated as critical.
data_description.learning_enabled: Enables persistent learning of air exchange, routines and forecast corrections. Default: on.
data_description.learning_max_duration_min: Longer sessions are not used as clean learning samples because weather, heating and occupancy effects increasingly dominate.

humidity_thresholds.name: Humidity thresholds
humidity_thresholds.description: Core limits for relative and absolute humidity. Default: 62/68/58% and 2.5/1.5/0.4 g/m³.

recommendation_thresholds.name: Recommendation thresholds
recommendation_thresholds.description: Defines when enough removable water is available for a recommendation. Default: automatic home-size threshold.

ventilation_timing.name: Ventilation duration & repetition
ventilation_timing.description: Time limits, stabilization and protection against overly frequent repeated recommendations.

efficiency.name: Benefit & temperature loss
efficiency.description: Balances additional moisture removal against heat loss.

health_limits.name: Mould & CO₂
health_limits.description: Limits for estimated surface humidity and CO₂ air quality.

learning.name: Learning model
learning.description: Controls whether and for how long FreshAirIQ uses valid ventilation sessions as learning samples.

profile.title: Operating profile
profile.description: Choose the priority. FreshAirIQ then shows only the fine-tuning inputs relevant to that profile.

data_description.operating_profile: Dehumidify = moisture removal has priority. Comfort = balanced decision. Summer cooling = passive cooling with acceptable moisture risk.

house.title: Property & occupants
house.description: Household, presence and night model. Residents with a phone can be assigned through person/device_tracker entities; residents without phones remain supported.

data.untracked_follow_household: Residents without trackers follow household presence

data_description.property_type: Distinguishes detached house, semi-detached house, mid/end-terrace house, apartment, maisonette and multi-family building, among others.
data_description.adult_occupants: Used together with learned values for daytime and overnight forecasts.
data_description.child_occupants: Children receive their own lower moisture contribution in the initial model.
data_description.night_start_hour: Convenient time selection instead of a numeric hour.
data_description.night_end_hour: End of the time window for which the overnight forecast is calculated and learned.
data_description.night_forecast_enabled: Enables the overnight forecast and adaptive night model.
data_description.adult_presence_entities: Assign the primary person/device_tracker entities to adult residents. Multiple residents can be selected.
data_description.child_presence_entities: Optional for children with their own tracker. Children without a tracker are still handled by household logic.
data_description.presence_sensor_entities: You can select any suitable available binary_sensor entities. They are soft supporting evidence; a single motion event is not automatically treated as confirmed human presence.
data_description.pet_safe_presence_entities: Sensors from the selection above that reliably detect real human presence even with pets. These signals may be weighted more strongly in pet mode.
data_description.pets_in_household: Enable when pets can trigger motion sensors. Conventional motion sensors are then weighted much less strongly to avoid phantom occupants.
data_description.untracked_follow_household: If at least one relevant tracker is definitely home, residents without trackers may be assumed present. If all relevant trackers are definitely away, they may be assumed absent. Uncertain states are handled conservatively.
data_description.adult_resident_names: Comma-separated in the same order as the adult trackers. Additional names may represent residents without their own tracker. Used locally for personal wording only.
data_description.child_resident_names: Comma-separated in the same order as child trackers. Children without trackers may also be named. Names are not used for direct action prompts to children.

energy.title: Heating system
energy.description: Choose the heating system. The next step shows only relevant cost inputs.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Default: notifications off, no recipients, scope “House”, all rooms, ventilate/close/completion/cooling/mould/sensor-error notifications on, night/learning off, minimum interval 90 minutes.

data_description.notifications_enabled: Master switch for all FreshAirIQ push notifications.
data_description.notification_targets: Select existing notify.* services. No push notifications are sent without a recipient.
data_description.notification_scope: House = central recommendations. Room = room-specific messages. Both = both levels.
data_description.notification_room_keys: Empty means all rooms. A selection limits room-specific messages to those rooms.
data_description.notification_cooldown_min: Prevents repeated identical notifications within this period.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.description: FreshAirIQ can show 1–365 days of compact daily ventilation and climate aggregates. High-resolution temperature points remain limited to 30 days for performance.

data_description.statistics_days: Allowed range: 1–365 days. Compact daily ventilation and climate aggregates are retained long term; high-resolution temperature points remain limited to 30 days.

reset_learning.title: Reset learning
reset_learning.description: Deletes learned room air-exchange values, routines and the night model. Room configuration, options and statistics remain intact.

sort_rooms.title: Sort rooms
sort_rooms.description: Drag the rooms into the desired order.

contact_delays_room.title: Choose room
contact_delays_room.description: Configure opening delay separately for every contact.

contact_delays.title: Opening delays · {room_name}
contact_delays.description: Each contact must remain open for this duration before a ventilation session starts. Field names are entity IDs.

air_quality.title: Optional sensors & outdoor air
air_quality.description: VOC/TVOC, PM2.5 and illuminance are fully optional. They do not change humidity/ventilation physics, the ml forecast or the learning model. When enabled, they may produce supplemental recommendations and are included in the local 30-day diagnostics for future feature development. Pollen and wind remain separate outdoor-air influences.

data.pollen_strict_veto: Block normal ventilation above limit (Default: on)
data.wind_orientation_enabled: Use window orientation with wind data (Default: on)

data_description.pollen_enabled: Requires a pollen-index sensor under the outdoor-air source.
data_description.pollen_max: Above this index, normal ventilation is postponed when the veto is active; critical mould/CO₂ risk remains prioritized.
data_description.pollen_strict_veto: Off = pollen is displayed but does not block a recommendation.
data_description.wind_orientation_enabled: Uses only available local wind data; without wind direction the factor remains neutral.
data_description.voc_warn: Threshold for optional VOC/TVOC-based supplemental recommendations. It does not change canonical ventilation calculations.
data_description.voc_critical: Critical VOC threshold for diagnostics and future prioritisation. It does not change the existing ventilation physics.
data_description.pm25_warn: Threshold for optional PM2.5-based supplemental recommendations. It does not change canonical ventilation calculations.
data_description.pm25_critical: Critical PM2.5 threshold for diagnostics and future prioritisation. It does not change the existing ventilation physics.
data_description.humidify_below_rh: Only used when a room humidifier is configured.
data_description.shade_above_temp_c: Only used when covers/blinds are configured.
data_description.shade_min_illuminance_lx: Used only when illuminance input is enabled. It refines existing shading recommendations; ventilation calculations remain unchanged.
data_description.voc_sensor_enabled: Off = configured VOC/TVOC sensors are not read, shown or used for supplemental recommendations. The room assignment remains stored.
data_description.pm25_sensor_enabled: Off = configured PM2.5 sensors are not read, shown or used for supplemental recommendations. The room assignment remains stored.
data_description.illuminance_sensor_enabled: Off = configured illuminance sensors are not read, shown or used to refine shading recommendations. The room assignment remains stored.

energy_details.title: Heating costs · {heating_system}
energy_details.description: Used only to estimate reheating cost after ventilation-related temperature loss.

data_description.heat_pump_cop: The higher the COP/seasonal performance factor, the less electricity is required for reheating.
data_description.gas_efficiency: Usable share of the purchased gas energy.
data_description.oil_kwh_per_liter: Typical heating value; can be adjusted to the fuel being used.

profile_details.title: Operating profile · {profile}
profile_details.description: Dehumidify tolerates somewhat more temperature loss for effective moisture removal. Comfort balances moisture and energy. Summer cooling uses cooling-specific parameters only.

data.cooling_min_outdoor_delta_c: Outdoor air at least this much cooler (Default: 2.0)
data.cooling_max_moisture_gain_5min_ml: Maximum tolerated moisture gain in 5 min (Default: 60.0)

data_description.forecast_horizon_min: Allowed range: 1–120 minutes. For immediate ventilation decisions, 5–20 minutes is usually the most informative range.

cross_ventilation.title: Cross ventilation
cross_ventilation.description: Define only real airflow paths where two rooms opened at the same time can create effective cross ventilation. Default: empty, so no additional cross-ventilation bonus. Available room keys: {room_keys}

data_description.cross_ventilation_pairs: Format: room_a+room_b. Separate multiple pairs with commas. Example: living_room+bedroom,office+child_room. A bonus applies only when both associated ventilation contacts are active.
data_description.cross_zone_connections: Only required when a cross-ventilation pair is physically connected across different floors/areas. Same format. Example: living_room+gym. Pairs within the same area need no entry here.

personalisation.title: Personal recommendations
personalisation.description: Adapts wording and comfort context to your household. Physical forecasts and health, mould and CO₂ safety limits remain unchanged. Defaults: enabled, balanced, automatic night handling.

data_description.personalisation_enabled: Uses household context and learned behaviour only for more suitable recommendations.
data_description.thermal_preference: Warm, balanced or cool. Safety decisions are never weakened.
data_description.personal_priority: Indoor climate, balanced or energy saving. Applies only within the comfort layer.
data_description.night_window_preference: Automatic, prefer closed at night, or open at night is acceptable.

contact_references.title: Reference air per window/door · {room_name}
contact_references.description: Optional: For each opening into another air zone, select a complete temperature/humidity sensor pair. Outdoor windows stay empty and use the normal outdoor or room reference.

building.title: Building
building.description: Describes the building only. Residents and presence are maintained separately in the resident profile so the same values are not entered twice.

data_description.property_type: Base profile for the building envelope and air exchange. This is the same setting used by the dashboard settings.

residents.title: Resident profile & presence
residents.description: Central place for residents, presence, comfort and night settings. The same values are used by the dashboard settings; names and trackers are not maintained a second time elsewhere.

residents.name: Residents
residents.description: Counts, names and associated person/device trackers.

presence.name: Presence
presence.description: Additional presence signals and handling of residents without their own tracker.

personalisation.name: Comfort & personal recommendations
personalisation.description: Adjusts comfort wording and non-safety-critical weighting only. The physical forecast remains unchanged.

night.name: Night
night.description: Time window and activation of the overnight forecast.

resident_profiles.name: Personal IQ profiles & devices
resident_profiles.description: This is the same profile structure used by the dashboard settings. The dashboard is recommended for convenient room and device assignment; full native editability remains available here.

data.untracked_follow_household: Residents without trackers follow household status (Default: on)

data_description.adult_occupants: Adults who regularly live in the household.
data_description.adult_resident_names: Optional, comma-separated and matching the order of the adult trackers.
data_description.adult_presence_entities: Person or device_tracker entities for adult residents.
data_description.child_occupants: Children who regularly live in the household.
data_description.child_resident_names: Optional, comma-separated. Children without trackers may also be named.
data_description.child_presence_entities: Optional for children with their own tracker.
data_description.pets_in_household: Reduces the weight of conventional motion sensors so pets are not interpreted as residents.
data_description.pet_safe_presence_entities: Sensors that reliably indicate human presence even when pets are present.
data_description.untracked_follow_household: Estimates residents without trackers from the reliable household presence state.
data_description.personalisation_enabled: Uses household context for more suitable recommendations; health and safety limits remain unchanged.
data_description.thermal_preference: Household comfort default. Individual profiles may override it.
data_description.night_start_hour: Start of the overnight evaluation period.
data_description.night_end_hour: End of the overnight evaluation period.
data_description.resident_room_profiles: Native technical representation of the same personal profiles used by the dashboard. The data stays local; graphical editing in the FreshAirIQ dashboard settings is easier.

threshold.title: Intelligent ventilation threshold
threshold.description: Choose how FreshAirIQ determines the house ventilation threshold. Automatic (recommended): expected daily moisture generation is divided by four and constrained to 6–12% of currently monitored water. From May through September the threshold is reduced by 25% before 09:00 and from 19:00 when outside air is at least 2°C cooler than average indoor temperature. Health, mould and critical CO₂ rules take priority.

data_description.threshold_mode: Automatic needs no additional value. Percentage and fixed mL open only the relevant input on the next step.

threshold_percent.title: Ventilation threshold · Percentage
threshold_percent.description: Set only the share of currently monitored total water that must be removable before normal whole-house ventilation is recommended.

data_description.min_potential_percent_total_water: Example: 10% of 6,000 mL currently monitored water gives a 600 mL ventilation threshold.

threshold_fixed.title: Ventilation threshold · Fixed mL
threshold_fixed.description: Set only the removable moisture potential in mL from which FreshAirIQ considers normal whole-house ventilation worthwhile.

data_description.min_potential_total_ml: Example: 500 mL means combined removable potential must reach at least 500 mL. Health, mould and critical CO₂ rules may intervene earlier.

diagnostics_sharing.title: Diagnostics sharing
diagnostics_sharing.description: Optional and off by default. FreshAirIQ prepares the technically complete retained diagnostics history locally for analysis, removes or pseudonymises direct identifiers, and transfers large histories in chunks. After the first acknowledged full sync, only new diagnostic records are transferred. This staging configuration connects only to the local Diagnostics Hub on the private LAN. Transmission starts only after explicitly selecting a mode other than Off; any later public deployment will require HTTPS.

data_description.diagnostics_reporting_mode: Off, only for detected problems, nightly, or weekly. A future nightly upload is deterministically distributed between 02:00 and 03:59 local time.
data_description.diagnostics_include_client_context: Optional for compatibility analysis. Exact device names, serial numbers and exact device models are not sent to the Hub.

error.outdoor_source_required: Select a local weather entity or both temperature and humidity sensors.
error.ventilation_contact_required: Select at least one ventilation contact.
error.room_volume_required: Enter either room volume or complete length, width and height.
error.room_volume_too_small: Room volume must be at least 2 m³.
error.room_dimensions_required: For dimension-based volume, enter complete length, width and height.
error.invalid_humidity_order: Humidity values must be ordered logically: target ≤ ventilation start ≤ high humidity.
error.invalid_delta_order: Humidity differences are inconsistent: close difference ≤ high-humidity minimum difference ≤ normal minimum difference.
error.invalid_duration_order: Minimum ventilation duration must not exceed maximum duration.
error.invalid_mould_order: The mould warning threshold must be lower than the critical mould threshold.
error.invalid_co2_order: The CO₂ warning threshold must be lower than the critical CO₂ threshold.
error.contact_reference_pair_required: A local window/door reference requires both temperature and humidity from the same air zone.
error.outdoor_pair_required: Outdoor temperature and outdoor humidity must be selected together or both left empty.
error.resident_profiles_invalid: The resident profile assignments are invalid. Use a JSON object or edit them from the FreshAirIQ dashboard settings.

data.name: Room name
data.moisture_sources: Moisture sources in the room (Default: none)

identity.name: Room
identity.description: Name, level and whether the room participates in calculations.

sensors.name: Sensors & windows
sensors.description: Sensors and contacts FreshAirIQ uses for this room.

geometry.name: Room size
geometry.description: Enter either the volume directly or length, width and height.

optional_sensors.name: Optional sensors
optional_sensors.description: Only configure sensors that are actually available in this room.

properties.name: Room properties
properties.description: Special properties such as shower, bathtub or sauna. Default: no moisture source configured.

data_description.name: Freely selectable display name. FreshAirIQ derives a stable internal room key from it.
data_description.temperature: Required for calculated rooms. Prefer a sensor that measures the actual room air.
data_description.humidity: Required for calculated rooms. Do not place the sensor directly in splash water, above a radiator or immediately next to a window.
data_description.contacts: Select all windows/doors through which FreshAirIQ should detect ventilation for this room.
data_description.contact_mode: “At least one open” = any selected contact starts ventilation. “All open” = only all selected contacts together count as an active ventilation path.
data_description.volume: Enter the volume directly in m³ OR use length, width and height.
data_description.length: Only required when no direct room volume is entered.
data_description.width: Only required when no direct room volume is entered.
data_description.height: Only required when no direct room volume is entered.
data_description.reference_temperature: Optional for special cases, e.g. a conservatory as a local reference. Otherwise FreshAirIQ uses the normal outdoor-air reference.
data_description.reference_humidity: Optional; use together with the alternative reference temperature.
data_description.co2: Optional. With a CO₂ sensor, FreshAirIQ can assess air quality in addition to humidity.
data_description.floor: Helps with room grouping and cross ventilation. You can create custom areas under “Floors & areas”.
data_description.include_in_calculations: Off = the room remains visible but does not affect recommendations, house balance, statistics or learning.
data_description.moisture_sources: Multiple selection is possible: shower, bathtub and/or sauna. This is only context for detection; FreshAirIQ activates a moisture source only when the measurements support it.
data_description.ventilation_threshold_mode: Automatic uses the established default room threshold. Percentage and fixed modes override it only for this room; health and safety rules take priority.
data_description.ventilation_threshold_percent: Percentage mode only: share of the current water content in this room air.
data_description.ventilation_threshold_ml: Fixed mode only: removable moisture potential from which this room may be prioritized individually.
